test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Foundation'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the context **of the sentence, the phrase "a strong reading foundation" **indicates** the basis or groundwork upon which a child's reading skills are developed.
 
• A** reading foundation includes** fundamental skills and abilities necessary for reading, such as letter recognition, phonics, vocabulary, and comprehension.
 
• **The sentence highlights **that reading strategies are designed to help children develop a strong reading foundation, one that is built with confidence, engagement, and joy.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *Children learn to walk and talk naturally, **(1) but** that is not the case with reading. Reading strategies are designed to help your child develop a strong reading **(2) foundation** one built with confidence engagement and joy. As a parent, you are most likely always looking for (3) _____ that make your child want to learn. We are here to help you and your child on their journey as a (4) ________ reader. Try some reading strategy suggestions below for kids (5) _______ are beginning to read all the way to those reading advanced chapter books. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options:
 
 
• **Presumption: **This option does not fit well in the sentence. A presumption refers to a belief or assumption made without sufficient evidence, and it does not convey the idea of building or developing something.
 
• **Corporation:** This option does not fit well in the sentence. Corporation refers to a business organization, and it is not appropriate in the context of developing reading skills.
 
• **Fluctuation: **This option does not fit well in the sentence. Fluctuation refers to irregular changes or variations, and it does not convey the idea of building or developing a strong reading foundation.
